underlines.text: I hoped to find you reasonable

reference.text: I expected to find a more reasonable young woman.

underlines.text: but depend upon it I will carry my point

reference.text: You are to understand, Miss Bennet, that I came here with the determined resolution of carrying my purpose; nor will I be dissuaded from it.

underlines.text: why Lady Catherine would not come in again and rest herself

reference.text: Mrs. Bennet, with great civility, begged her Ladyship to take some refreshment: but Lady Catherine very resolutely, and not very politely, declined eating anything; and then, rising up, said to Elizabeth,—

underlines.text: her calling here was prodigiously civil!

reference.text: Mrs. Bennet, all amazement, though flattered by having a guest of such high importance, received her with the utmost politeness.
